meta: Making tests with AI: from one lesson, AI writes easy, medium and hard question sets with answers in minutes. Name the levels, ask for explanations, and solve it yourself first.

muc.title: Tests at three levels
muc.text: From one lesson, AI can write easy, medium and hard question sets, with answers, in just a few minutes.

muc.title: Name the levels clearly
muc.text: Name the levels clearly, recall, understanding and application, and how many questions per level, so the test is balanced instead of all easy questions.

muc.title: Make AI explain the answers
muc.text: Ask AI to explain why the right answer is right and where the wrong options go wrong, because a clumsy explanation often points to a flawed question.

muc.title: Solve it yourself first
muc.text: Before handing out the test, solve each question yourself, because AI can still give wrong answers, especially for multi-step math problems.

muc.title: Ten multiple-choice questions
muc.text: Ask AI for ten multiple-choice questions on the lesson you just taught, four recall, four understanding, two application, with worked answers.
